result.title: Refining Roadside 4D Radar Vehicle Classification Using Point-Cloud Dispersion
result.summary: Roadside sensing infrastructure is essential for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), but cameras and legacy sensors are limited in range, weather robustness, and depth accuracy. 4D radar complements these modalities by resolving range, azimuth, elevation, and radial velocity under adverse conditions, though its sparse, noisy point clouds make reliable classification difficult. We present a roadside multi-sensor platform combining a 4D radar and stereo depth camera under synchronized acquisition, used to collect a real-world dataset. Our analysis reveals a substantial class-distribution discrepancy between modalities, most notably a strong radar confusion between passenger cars and motorcycles (49.01% and\ 48.60% of the dataset). To address this, we propose a Neyman-Pearson-based binary classifier on the temporally-smoothed 2D positional standard deviation of radar point cloud clusters, reducing classification error from 52.1% to 42.7%. This lightweight and edge-deployable approach improves radar-only classification reliability and lays the foundation for future camera-radar fusion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文搭建路侧 4D 雷达与双目深度相机同步采集平台并构建数据集，针对雷达对乘用车与摩托车的严重混淆，提出基于时间平滑点云簇二维位置标准差的 Neyman-Pearson 二分类器。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于路侧感知的雷达点云目标分类，不涉及 VLM 内部表示、latent 推理状态或证据获取与停止决策，也无可核查的方法借鉴线索，故排除。
